name: g72_yawn_charger_electric
purpose: Step G72: Golurk (No Guard, grounded Ghost-Ground) charges Phantom Force under Electric Terrain (Pincurchin's Electric Surge). Sylveon (faster) yawns the charging Golurk on the locked turn before its hit: the No Guard target is not a miss, and the Electric Terrain refusal is skipped for a semi-invulnerable target, so the Yawn volatile starts with no -activate line. Its residual on the next turn ends while Golurk charges Phantom Force again: the sleep is not refused either (still semi-invulnerable), so Golurk falls asleep with no -activate line.
